projectDescription: Lumina is a self-ordering kiosk platform for restaurants that integrates with Square for menus, payments, and loyalty.
keyFeatures: Square integration for menus, prices, and payments
Remy operator app for remote kiosk management
Kiosk profiles for multi-device and multi-location setups
Menu groups mirroring Square catalog categories
Promotional collections for featured items, discounts, and loyalty
Square Loyalty integration with guest enrollment at the kiosk
Customizable welcome screen with media and overlays
Secure kiosk lock mode with PIN-based admin access
publicApiSurface: Remy (operator app) — manage kiosks, profiles, menus, devices
Lumina Kiosk app — iPad guest-facing ordering interface
Square Integration — connect Square account, sync catalog
Devices tab — register and manage kiosk devices
Menus tab — create menus, menu groups, and collections
Locations tab — manage item availability per location
Profile settings — welcome experience, checkout, security PIN
